canonical_name: Remote Access Not Through Managed Access Points
description: Remote access to organizational systems does not route through managed network access control points. This signal indicates that remote connections may bypass security monitoring, filtering, and access controls.
applicability: Applicable to all remote access configurations. Includes VPN gateways, remote desktop services, jump servers, and any mechanisms for external access to organizational systems.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through remote access architecture review, network access point inventory, and traffic flow analysis.
